title: Add backoff, jitter and abort to the retry helper
prompt: `retry(fn, options)` in this project retries a failing async function with a constant delay. Extend it as described in README.md: exponential backoff with a cap, optional jitter with an injectable random source, a `shouldRetry` predicate, an `onRetry` hook, and cancellation through an AbortSignal. Existing constant-delay behaviour (when none of the new options is given) must stay the same. Run the tests with `npm test`.
